We’re both pretty outdoorsy and dabble a bit in the prepper life so it wasn’t an odd question to ask, and I responded with yes. He then slid a knife to me and asked me to check it out. He asked me so last minute and I feel like it would mean a lot for me to be there for him and his soon-to-be wife.
